text:
tanya_cs: Heads-up — Novacare onboarding flagged a mismatch vs their contracted SLOs. They expect median p50 <150ms and p95 <250ms for /chat and /complete routes. Our onboard telemetry shows p50 ~160ms and p95 ~420ms during business hours. Need an evidence bundle and remediation plan before renewal review.

devin_eng: yikes. do we have the breakdown by region and model? could be a hotspot in eu-west.

otto_sre: pulling infra view. preliminary looks like eu-west-2 queueing spikes aligned with a daily batch job at 02:00 UTC that pushes long-context requests. Also, a small percentage of calls are using sync mode with 3s client-side timeouts.

mira_product: are they on Hosted or Dedicated? billing shows Dedicated tier with burst on shared pool. If it's queueing, we can bump capacity for their tenant short-term.

tanya_cs: they're on Dedicated w/ reserved burst. Ops will need lead time. Ben — any constraints from finance on short-term capacity increases?

ben_fin: we can approve a one-time burst charge for 7 days if needed; will need a cost estimate.

slo_bot: Automated SLO snapshot: https://redwood-ops/attachments/NOV-992/slo_overview.png. 30d windows: availability 99.96%, p95 latency (chat) 412ms, p95 (complete) 398ms.

devin_eng: thanks. I recommend 3 prongs: (1) enable prefix/KV caching for their heavy prompt templates, (2) force streaming on compatible SDKs to reduce tail, (3) schedule a canary scale-up on their dedicated pool during peak hours.

tanya_cs: ok. what's the expected p95 impact estimate for each? need numbers for the customer deck.

devin_eng: rough numbers: caching -> ~25% p95 reduction for long repeated prefixes, streaming -> ~30% on generate tails, scale-up -> removes queueing spikes (~40% improvement at peak). Combined could get p95 near 200-230ms. I'll validate with a short lab run.

otto_sre: lab run scheduled tonight against a replay of their traces. I'll capture pre/post 95th latency and queue lengths.

mira_product: I'll draft a customer-facing SLO report (one pager + appendix) that explains the fixes and timeline. Want it to be non-technical for Novacare execs but include an ops appendix for their SREs.

ben_fin: also prepare a credit option: if we miss committed targets next billing period, propose a prorated credit formula. I'll need the SLA window and hit/miss thresholds.

tanya_cs: action items: 1) Otto run replay and post results (owner: otto_sre, due: 24h). 2) Devin implement caching flag canary + streaming ingress policy on tenant (owner: devin_eng, due: 48h). 3) Mira draft SLO one-pager + appendix (owner: mira_product, due: 36h). 4) Ben prepare cost + credit scenarios (owner: ben_fin, due: 48h). 5) Tanya schedule a customer call to present findings (owner: tanya_cs, due: 72h).

devin_eng: snippet I'll use for canary config: ```yaml
tenant: novacare
policies:
  - name: force_streaming_if_sdk>=1.4
    action: enable_streaming
  - name: prefix_kv_cache
    ttl: 48h
    scope: tenant
    canary: true
```

otto_sre: replay started. running 2x real-time for 30m. I'll upload CSV to the attachment link once done.

slo_bot: upload complete: https://redwood-ops/attachments/NOV-992/replay-results.csv

mira_product: drafting doc now, will share draft in this thread.

ben_fin: cost estimate for 7-day burst: ~$4.2k (GPU hour premium included). Will attach a table.

tanya_cs: good. aim to avoid blanket credits. prefer technical remediation + short burst while we validate. If we still miss, present the credit as a gesture for renewal.

devin_eng: noted. I'll get the canary flag out today and monitor p95 via the SLO dashboard.

otto_sre: initial replay results posted, p95 pre 418ms -> post-canary-caching+streaming 222ms in lab conditions. Upload: https://redwood-ops/attachments/NOV-992/lab-summary.png

mira_product: draft shared: https://redwood-ops/attachments/NOV-992/slo-onepager-draft.pdf — includes expected improvements, timeline, and what we need from Novacare (enable SDK streaming toggle + confirm heavy prompt templates).

tanya_cs: great work. I'll loop in customer and book the review call for tomorrow 10:30 PT. Keeping this thread live for results and any rollback notes. :white_check_mark:
